svg.aria-label: Illustrative, with invented counts. Five channels (work, family, community, life, subscription) pour in inputs at very different rates; each becomes one uniform input shape that keeps its source. The agent estimates each item in context and assigns a tier; the share derives from the tier (critical 24, high 12, normal 6, low 3, trace 1) inside a layer budget of B = 64. Received is not given: subscription sends 402 inputs and ends with no share, family sends 14 and holds 24. When a new critical item (visa-docs) arrives with the layer full, others yield: lease steps down from high to normal, relnotes and ci-main merge into release, forum and newsletter are withdrawn, and 4 cells stay empty. The person comes back and leaves an annotation; it is saved, then acknowledged on the next pass, which is not the same as the action being done. The same state is then shown as four of its twelve forms: a treemap, a phone home screen with the top three asks, a watch glance and a timeline.
svg.title: Fold: one attention budget, one state, many forms
